# ADR-3266: AWS backups: Cross-region backup copy setting for vault 2

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Single-region disasters destroy local backups.

## Decision

Critical vaults MUST enable a cross-region backup copy setting for vault 2 (AWS-backups-2).

## Consequences

Copies land in a isolated account.
